title: Contains Duplicate (Sort)
prompt:
Given an integer array `nums`, return `true` if any value appears at least twice, and `false` if every element is distinct.

**Approach:** Sort the array first, then check adjacent elements for duplicates. This uses O(1) extra space (ignoring the sort) but O(n log n) time.

**Requirements:**
1. Define and export `containsDuplicate(nums: number[]): boolean` in `solution.ts`
2. Create a sorted copy using `[...nums].sort((a, b) => a - b)`
3. Iterate through consecutive pairs; if any two adjacent elements are equal, return `true`
4. Return `false` if no duplicates found

**Examples:**
```typescript
containsDuplicate([1, 2, 3, 1])  // true
containsDuplicate([1, 2, 3, 4])  // false
containsDuplicate([])            // false
```

**Complexity:** O(n log n) time, O(n) extra space (for sorted copy)
hints: Sorting brings duplicates next to each other
Use [...nums].sort((a, b) => a - b) to get a sorted copy without mutating the original
After sorting, compare each element with its neighbor
If sorted[i] === sorted[i - 1], you found a duplicate
